contentText:
Apple says it will have "limited" iPhone Duo models for sale in stores, according to a report from Reuters . The iPhone Duo launches on Friday, October 23rd, but online preorders quickly sold out , with some delivery estimates extending into next year.

"On Friday morning, our teams look forward ​to welcoming customers at Apple Stores to experience iPhone Duo ​and the incredible iPhone line-up for themselves," Apple said in a statement to Reuters . "Apple Stores will ‌have ⁠limited iPhone Duo available for walk-in customers, and we're working hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as quickly as possible."
